notes:
2299 unique URLs, 31/31 days. Target days: 2026-09-30=81, 2026-10-10=54, 2026-10-20=96. Route: robots.txt (200, permissive, no Crawl-delay) advertises /sitemap.xml + /sitemapNews.xml. Sitemap index lists monthly /sitemapNoticiasYYYYMM.xml (202609 200, 447 KB; 202610 200, 416 KB) but those url lists carry NO at all (only loc/changefreq/priority), so they give URLs without dates. /sitemapNews.xml (200, 73 KB) does carry news:publication_date but covers only ~2 days. Closed routes tried: /wp-json/wp/v2/posts 404, /feed 404, /sitemapNoticias20260925.xml 404, /sitemapNews20261020.xml 404, /2026/10/20/ date archive 404. Working route: the outlet's own listing https://www.exitosanoticias.pe/ultimas-noticias/?p=N, 200, 15
cards per page, newest first, deep pagination (p=130 -> 2026-10-01, p=161 first page fully older than window; 161 requests in 81 s). Each card states the publication date as text 26 de Octubre, 2026 ; that text date equals the article page JSON-LD datePublished exactly on 4 re-fetched samples (2026-09-30, 2026-10-10 x2, 2026-10-20; 6.6k-8.0k chars of body text each), so no per-article fetch is needed. Script stops when a page's newest date is before the window start, dedupes by URL, filters to 2026-09-25..2026-10-25, writes URLYYYY-MM-DD.
